text.en:
Pending approval of the General Appropriation Act for the fiscal year nineteen hundred and
forty-six, the sums necessary to pay the salaries and wages of all officers and employees who, on August
fifteen, nineteen hundred and forty-five, are actually rendering service to the Commonwealth Government
under this items of appropriations authorized in Commonwealth Act Numbered Six hundred and fifty-four and
in Administrative Ordered Numbered Five, dated May twenty-five, nineteen hundred and forty five, and in
Executive Ordered Numbered Eighteen-W, dated August thirty-first, nineteen hundred anmd forty-four, as
well as the sums necessary to pay the running and incidental expenses of activities provided in said Act and
Administrative and Executive Orders which, on August fifteen, nineteen hundred and forty-five, are in actual
operation, are hereby appropriated for the operation of the Government of the Commonwealth of the
Philippines for a period of three months beginning July first, nineteen hundred and forty-five. The following
sums, or so much thereof as may be necessary, are likewise hereby appropriated, for the objects and purposes
herein specified for the operation of the government branches concerned for a period of three months
beginning July first, nineteen hundred and forty-five:
Special and General Purposes
1. For the operating expenses of the National Board of Inquiry created by Executive Order No. 53, dated June
8, 1945; Provided, That this appropriation shall be available to cover expenditures incurred on and after June
DEPARTMENT OF FINANCE
Special Purpose
1. For aid to provinces, cities, municipalities and municipal districts to help them meet their operating
expenses for essential ordinary services: Provided, That each province, city, municipality or municipal district
shall receive not less than fifty per centum of its average quarterly expenditures for essential ordinary services
for the fiscal year ending June 30, 1941: Provided, further, That if the data for the fiscal year 1941 are not
available, the latest available data shall be used for this purpose. Any balance of this aid remaining
unexpended on September 30 1945, shall revert to the General Fund of the National
Government-------10,000,000.00
